g.title: Sheet.50
g.text: The network has 4096 IP addresses (16*256):from 172.16.32.0 to 172.16.47.255

g.title: Sheet.69

g.title: Sheet.70
g.text: Hence, the network has 4094 usable IPs(the pattern value*256 - 2)
